decisive_items: A 36-year-old woman with a 17-year history of migraine headaches
a right orbital and medial cheek headache radiating to the right lateral jaw, ear, and down the right suboccipital region
This treatment also failed to resolve her symptoms
response.rationale: Chronic migraine is supported by the long-standing history and recurrent severe episodes; the new headache pattern lacks autonomic features required for TAC, and medication overuse is not clearly established.

rejected.why: Describes a failed intervention, not a diagnosis.
No explicit overuse frequency or duration criteria met.
Absence of prominent autonomic symptoms (lacrimation, nasal congestion) argues against TAC.
